overview_description.description:
Elkrem provides hardware and software tools for developers to build Blockchain connected IoT products.  

The software and hardware tools allows anyone with minimal technical background, to build internet connected products that accept cryptocurrencies and communicate with different blockchain and decentralized protocols including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Swarm, Whisper, IPFS, IOTA and others.
